# GroupBy

Groups the objects of an array by the value of one of their properties.

## Signature

```jyro
# fragment
GroupBy(items, fieldName)
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `items` | array | The array to group, which is left unchanged. Null is read as the empty array; any other type that is not an array is a runtime error. Elements that are not objects are left out. |
| `fieldName` | string | The name of the property to group by, matched exactly, case included. A number or a boolean is read as its string form, and null as the empty string. A property whose value is an array, an object or a function is a runtime error. |

## Returns

Object. A new object with one property per group. Its key is the string form of the property's value, and the text null for an object whose value is null or that lacks the property. Its value is an array of the objects in that group, in their original order. The empty object when items holds no object. Never null.

## Example

`GroupBy([{"t": "a"}, {"t": "b"}, {"t": "a"}], "t")` returns `{"a": [{"t": "a"}, {"t": "a"}], "b": [{"t": "b"}]}`.
